svg.title: Full test run: plain bash 53.0 seconds, indo 16.1 seconds, 3.3x
svg.desc: Claude Code with Sonnet 5.5 on 54 repos. Median of 3 runs. Plain bash 53.0s, indo plus the Agent Skill 16.1s (3.3x). Both setups 24 of 24 correct. Cost 1.02x (95% CI 0.95x to 1.07x), about 0.02 USD per run.
